title:
One Dead, Vehicles Torched as Violence Erupts at DP Kindiki's UDA Meeting
                in Embu
description:
One person was killed and at least six vehicles torched when youths clashed
                with police during Deputy President Kithure Kindiki's UDA meeting at Nembure Stadium, Embu County.
imageAlt:
One Dead, Vehicles Torched as Violence Erupts at DP Kindiki's UDA Meeting
                in Embu

title:
Linda Mwananchi Faces Questions Over Leadership as Claims Emerge of Battle
                for Party Control and Presidential Ticket
description:
Unverified claims have emerged alleging a power struggle within the Linda
                Mwananchi movement over control of Ukombozi People's Party (UPP), with Babu Owino and James Orengo
                reportedly seeking leadership roles.
imageAlt:
Linda Mwananchi Faces Questions Over Leadership as Claims Emerge of Battle
                for Party Control and Presidential Ticket

title:
KCB Head of Data Protection Rosemary Koech Dies at 40; Autopsy Confirms
                Suicide
description:
Rosemary Chemutai Koech Kimwatu, 40, Head of Data Protection at KCB Bank
                Group, died by suicide on August 21, 2026, at her Ngong home. An autopsy confirmed the cause of death as
                her family revealed she faced marital and financial difficulties..
imageAlt: KCB Head of Data Protection Rosemary Koech Dies at 40; Autopsy Confirms Suicide

title:
Vihiga Students to Benefit as Government Unveils Career-Focused University
                Funding Plan
description:
Education CS Julius Ogamba has announced a new Universal Student Funding
                Model that will prioritise students' career choices over their parents' financial status, under the
                Tertiary Education Placement and Funding Bill, 2026.
imageAlt:
Vihiga Students to Benefit as Government Unveils Career-Focused University
                Funding Plan

title: Sifuna Fires Back at Ruto Over Uhuru Funding Claims
description:
Nairobi Senator Edwin Sifuna has ridiculed President William Ruto's claim
                that former President Uhuru Kenyatta is financing opposition activities, saying the President cited a
                newspaper headline instead of providing documentary evidence..
imageAlt: Sifuna Fires Back at Ruto Over Uhuru Funding Claims

title:
Mukumu Girls Fined Sh300,000 for Sharing Student Photo Without Parental
                Consent
description:
The Office of the Data Protection Commissioner has ordered Sacred Heart
                Mukumu Girls' High School to pay Sh300,000 compensation and recommended prosecution of its Board for
                unlawfully sharing a minor's photo.
imageAlt:
Mukumu Girls Fined Sh300,000 for Sharing Student Photo Without Parental
                Consent

title: Seven Killed After Helicopter Crashes Near Mount Ololokwe in Samburu
description:
Seven people, including Ecuador's intelligence chief and five Americans, died
                when a Eurocopter EC130 B4 crashed near Mount Ololokwe in Samburu County on Wednesday morning.
imageAlt: Seven Killed After Helicopter Crashes Near Mount Ololokwe in Samburu

title:
Homa Bay Political Violence: Linda Mwananchi Demands Answers from Governor
                Wanga, MP Kaluma
description:
The Linda Mwananchi movement is demanding investigations into violent attacks
                during its Homa Bay political tour, which left two people dead and dozens injured.
imageAlt:
Homa Bay Political Violence: Linda Mwananchi Demands Answers from Governor
                Wanga, MP Kaluma
